title: MetaBox
tagline: One Click Checkout for NFTs Cross-Chain and in any token (NFT.CLICK.BUY)
description:
One Click Checkout for NFTs Cross-Chain and in any token 

Our widget can integrate into any app with just little lines of code and handles the bridging and swapping and transferring of the NFT

Cross-chain minting meets one-tap payments. Serve customers of every stripe with The Box, empowering them with automatic swaps, built‑in bridging, and seamless secondary sales. It's all just clicks, from its developer-friendly backend to its consumer-friendly UX.

What's in the MetaBox?

- Built-In Bridging (Cross-Chain Minting)
The days of slow and stressful bridging are over. The Box automatically handles cross-chain transactions in seconds, so your users won't ever have to jump through hoops to get what they want, where they want it.

- Automatic Swaps (Cost-Efficient Exchange)
From dollars to DeFi, The Box lets your customers conduct end-to-end transactions in their currency of choice on their chain of choice, automatically exchanging tokens behind the scenes to keep their checkout process smooth and simple.

- Secondary Sales (Localized Listings) --coming soon
Sell out, then sell again — all from the same spot. No more leaving collectors in the lurch or sending them off to third-party pages. With The Box's secondary-market integration, your customers are guaranteed to always see the best listing, making for even more conversions right where you are.
how_its_made:
This project uses polygon and ethereum networks to deploy smart contracts for swapping, bridging and transferring for NFTs.
Next.js for building frontend
Solidity for building smart contracts
IPFS for storing NFTs and Widget metadata
LiFi, Covalent and Alchemy API for query data.
